text:
Chip Fields played Rochelle, one of J.J.'s girlfriends, in "J.J.'s New Career, Part 2" (Season 4, Episode 8, aired November 17, 1976), per [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chip_Fields) and [TVmaze](https://www.tvmaze.com/characters/204646/good-times-rochelle). I've dropped my earlier claim that her later Good Times role was Lynnetta Gordon: sources conflict on that, and it isn't needed for this answer.

CONFIDENCE: 88
